description: One bout in full by Boxerbook bout id, or by two boxers (two surnames, e.g. "Fury vs Joshua"): both boxers with records going in, status, result (winner, method, round, time), start_utc, venue, card, broadcasters, sources, Boxerbook forecast with its signals and the market consensus when known. Answers "have A and B ever fought" and "head to head": by names it returns their scheduled bout (else their latest) with head_to_head, and when they never met head_to_head alone says so, with each side's record, last fights and next bout. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

id.description: Boxerbook bout id (the id of a bout in any Boxerbook answer, or the number in a boxerbook.com/bouts/<id>/<slug> url)

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

query.description: instead of id: two boxers as "A vs B", two surnames, e.g. "Fury vs Joshua"

name: bout

cite.description: the markdown link to quote with any fact of this answer: Source: [Boxerbook](<url of the main page>)

display.description: the order to show the two names in: ['a','b'] or ['b','a'] (the better-known boxer first, as boxerbook.com does: more Wikipedia language links, then the Boxerbook rating, then pro bouts). a, b, winner, forecast.p_a and market.p_a keep their meaning (side a); only the display order changes

fight_week.description: facts said in fight-week videos (press conference, weigh-in, face-off, open workout): only accepted ones, at most 24; no predictions or opinions

fact.description: one sentence, read by a model from the video captions

quote.description: the words as spoken (auto captions), 40 words at most

video_url.description: the YouTube video at the moment of the quote

p_a.description: Boxerbook model probability that side a wins

head_to_head.description: the two boxers named in the query: whether and how often they met, the bout between them that is scheduled, and each side's record, last fights and next bout

last_fights.description: the last three completed bouts, newest first

result.description: W, L, D or NC for this side

last_fights.description: the last three completed bouts, newest first

result.description: W, L, D or NC for this side

bouts.description: the bouts between them, newest first (at most 5)

summary.description: one sentence: how often they met and with what result, or that they never fought; the scheduled date; both records

opening.description: the opening line (first live snapshot); /v1/bouts/{id} only

p_a.description: no-vig consensus probability of side a

merged_from.description: present when the id asked was a duplicate merged into this bout (the id asked; id and url are this bout's)

note.description: when the two never met: the head to head summary (no bout fields then)

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

signals.description: signals of the latest forecast: a and b per side (age, age_precision, record, layoff_days, last5, ko_rate, home, travel_km, mu_delta_12m, div_shift, listed_first, short_notice_days, weight_lb, missed_weight, amateur, height_cm, reach_cm, stance, ...) and bout (title, rounds, main, division, lead_days, replaced, weigh_diff_lb)

story.description: «The story of the fight» of a completed bout, in English: a report written from the broadcast commentary, Boxerbook data and the press, every sentence checked against its sources (the bout page lists them); paragraphs separated by a blank line, text only (the charts are on the page). Absent when the bout has none

weighin.description: the official weigh-in, per side when known: a commission sheet before the press

missed.description: true: missed weight (a press report); null: unknown
